branch_fingerprint.purpose: Bind the exact structural RFC branch authority independently of pagination so replay, preview and stale checks never depend on mutable current presentation.

canonical_payload.subordinates: array ordered by rfc_id ASC of {edge_id:uuid,rfc_id:uuid,revision:int>=1} for every active direct child

branch_fingerprint.canonicalization: Serialize the exact closed payload with LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical UTF-8 JSON: object keys sorted lexicographically, arrays preserved in declared order, separators ',' and ':', no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, finite JSON values only. Hash those exact UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256 and render lowercase hexadecimal.
branch_fingerprint.ordering: subordinates are ordered by child rfc_id ASC before canonicalization; insertion order, query page size and caller cursor never affect the fingerprint
included_authority: every active direct hierarchy edge identity
every active direct child RFC immutable identity
every active direct child current RFC revision
excluded_presentation: RFC numbers because immutable rfc_id is authority
branch_fingerprint.exclusion_rule: Excluded values are not hierarchy structural authority. Their owning revisions/evidence/review fingerprints govern their own mutations. Changes that are hierarchy-relevant must affect an included RFC revision, active edge identity/set, or the separate reviewed-risk fingerprint.
branch_fingerprint.performance: The full active child identity/revision stream may be scanned in indexed rfc_id order to compute the digest, but the implementation must not materialize an unbounded RfcDetail collection merely to hash it.

branch_cursor.filter_fingerprint_canonicalization: LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical UTF-8 JSON followed by SHA-256 lowercase hexadecimal
branch_cursor.transport_rule: This is the exact semantic CursorV1 body. LLD-12 transport/security may integrity-protect or opaquely encode the body for clients but may not alter its semantic fields.

mutation_response.detach_root: post-command child_rfc_id after it becomes parentless
mutation_response.no_change: Return the same deterministic current branch projection that a fresh material execution would have stored; committed replay returns only that immutable stored response.
mutation_response.continuation: null when at most 100 direct children exist; otherwise exact branch_cursor CursorV1 body for the 100th child
mutation_response.fingerprint: Always SOMA_RFC_BRANCH_FINGERPRINT_V1 over the full structural branch, not merely the returned page.
mutation_response.transaction_rule: For a fresh hierarchy command, construct the complete response after owner mutations and required audits are prepared/applied but before commit, using the same outer UnitOfWork. No post-commit ReadSnapshot may reconstruct the command response.
